headline: Microsoft confirms Copilot ‘super app’ coming this year
summary: Microsoft is developing an AI 'super app' combining Copilot's chat, coding, and agentic capabilities. CEO Satya Nadella confirmed its launch this year for consumer and commercial experiences. Copilot is rapidly evolving from chat to 'Autopilots'.

headline: Mark Zuckerberg is planning a big push into personal AI agents
summary: Meta is heavily investing in AI, with a major focus on personal AI agents. CEO Mark Zuckerberg previewed agents designed to act on users' behalf. This strategic push was announced during Meta's Q2 2026 earnings call.

headline: Qualcomm is raising phone chip prices starting September 1st
summary: Qualcomm will increase prices on all its processors, affecting future smartphone costs. CEO Cristiano Amon stated the price hikes begin on September 1st. This move follows previous rumors about rising chip expenses.

headline: xAI’s last-minute scramble to stop Minnesota’s anti-nudification app law
summary: xAI is suing Minnesota's Attorney General over a new state law targeting 'nudification' apps. The company claims the law forces it to restrict Grok Imagine's image-editing features. xAI argues the statute violates the First Amendment.

headline: The Defiant is a Story-Driven Shooter that Explores a Rarely Seen Side of WW2 | IGN Preview
summary: IGN offers hands-on impressions of 'The Defiant,' a new story-driven shooter. The game explores a gritty, rarely seen side of World War 2. It is specifically set during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

headline: Project Motor Racing Adds Free Holden Commodore, PC Triple-Screen Support in 2.1 Update
summary: Project Motor Racing receives a significant 2.1 update with new content. It includes a free Holden Commodore in a V8 Supercars DLC pack. The update also adds PC triple-screen support and rebuilds GT3/GT4 handling models.

headline: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma Gives Optimistic Outlook Despite Grim Fiscal Earnings Report
summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma maintains an optimistic outlook despite recent financial results. The company's Q4 2026 fiscal report showed a decline in earnings. Both content and hardware sales experienced a continuous drop.

headline: The $20 AstroAI S8 Cordless Jump Starter Is an Inexpensive, Yet Essential Addition to Your Car's Emergency Kit
summary: The AstroAI S8 is an inexpensive $20 cordless jump starter for cars. It offers a more convenient alternative to traditional jumper cables. This device is considered an essential addition to any car's emergency kit.

headline: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
summary: The US military launched 'heavy' retaliatory strikes against Iran. This action followed attempted Iranian ballistic missile attacks on American forces. The US asserted its right to defend its troops in the region.

headline: Cooler conditions on the way for parts of UK - but still no rain for drought-hit areas
summary: Cooler conditions are expected for parts of the UK after record-breaking temperatures. A cold front is moving in, particularly affecting areas of England. However, drought-hit regions are not forecast to receive any rain.

headline: How the UK's extreme heat is shifting the conversation about air-con
summary: The UK's extreme heat is prompting a renewed discussion about air conditioning. Debates center on the necessity of air-con despite its environmental costs. Questions are raised on balancing home adaptation with carbon reduction goals.

headline: Homes and caravan park evacuated due to major heath fire in Suffolk
summary: A major heath fire in Suffolk has led to evacuations of homes and a caravan park. Seventeen fire crews are actively involved in combating the large blaze. Local residents have been advised to avoid the affected area.
